question: What will be the percentage change in Alphabet class A (GOOGL) stock (GOOGL on Yahoo Finance) from the close on 2026-08-21 to the close on 2026-09-21?
resolution_criteria: Resolves to 100 x (close on 2026-09-21 / close on 2026-08-21 - 1), using daily closes of GOOGL on Yahoo Finance. If there is no close on 2026-09-21, the last close before it is used.
research:
I found a likely starting price: GOOGL appears to have closed at **$344.82 on 2026-08-21**. Nothing has happened yet that settles the question. Search results kept including articles dated after 2026-08-24, and I left all of them out. Every page fetch failed (the proxy refused the connection), including Yahoo Finance, so the figures below come from search-result summaries and should be checked.

## 1. Resolution source
- Yahoo Finance GOOGL daily history decides the outcome. I could not open it. [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/GOOGL/)
- 2026-08-21: StockAnalysis lists GOOGL with open 342.58, high 346.20, low 340.40, **close 344.82** (adjusted 344.60), up 1.22% on the day, volume about 20.8M. Yahoo should show the same close; please confirm it. [StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/googl/history/)
- 2026-08-21: Two other listings agree. Class C (GOOG) closed at 341.75, and the Toronto-listed shares rose 1.13% to C$54.54 after falling 1.10% on 08-20. [GOOG history](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/goog/history/), [TSX:GOOG](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/tsx/GOOG/history/)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet. The one-month window has only just started.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-08-19: Alphabet said it will present at the Goldman Sachs Communacopia + Technology Conference. [Alphabet IR](https://abc.xyz/investor/news/default.aspx)
- 2026-08-15: Berkshire Hathaway's 13F filing showed it added about $17B to its Alphabet stake, making Alphabet its third-largest holding. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/15/berkshire-adds-17-billion-to-alphabet-stake.html)
- 2026-08-04: The stock reached about $377.65 after a rebound of about 18.9%. From there to the 08-21 close of 344.82 is a drop of about 9%. [Yahoo/Fool](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/alphabet-stock-46-since-last-140417535.html)
- 2026-08-03: GOOGL rose about 5% intraday after Morgan Stanley reassured investors about Alphabet's heavy AI infrastructure spending. [Motley Fool](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/03/why-alphabet-stock-popped-today/)
- 2026-07-22: Q2 results:
  - Revenue was $119.8B, up 24% from a year earlier.
  - Google Cloud revenue was $24.77B, up 82%.
  - EPS was $9.11, boosted by gains on equity holdings.
  - 2026 capital spending guidance rose to $195-205B, from $180-190B. Commentators flagged a sharp fall in free cash flow.
  - [Vantage](https://www.vantagemarkets.com/en/academy/alphabet-stock-outlook/), [TradingKey](https://www.tradingkey.com/analysis/stocks/us-stocks/262008961-alphabet-googl-stock-price-forecast-2026-google-cloud-tradingkey)
- 2026-05-13: GOOGL set its all-time high close (Macrotrends). I could not get the exact price. [Macrotrends](https://www.macrotrends.net/stocks/charts/GOOGL/alphabet/stock-price-history)
- Pending: Judge Brinkema's remedies decision in the ad tech antitrust case had not been issued as of the cutoff. The parties were still split over divestiture versus behavioral remedies. [Beinsure](https://beinsure.com/news/google-and-doj-remain-divided-over-final-ad-tech-remedies/)

## 4. Base rates
- 2026-08-05: Options expiring 08-07 near the $362.50 strike priced implied volatility at about 42-45%. That is inflated because it was measured right after earnings and the big move. [Investing.com](https://cn.investing.com/equities/google-inc-options)
- My rough sizing, an inference rather than a sourced figure:
  - At 30-40% annualized volatility, one month gives a standard deviation of about 8.5-11.5%.
  - At more typical realized volatility of 25-30%, it is about 7-9%.
- The move from the early-August high back to 344.82 shows that 9-10% swings within a month have happened recently.
- I could not get a full table of monthly GOOGL returns. As a general pattern, about two-thirds of one-month moves fall within plus or minus 1 standard deviation, and moves beyond plus or minus 15% are rare outside earnings months. Note that September has historically been a weak month for equities.

## 5. Other forecasts
- Polymarket runs GOOGL markets for a September month-end close (a ladder of strikes from $290 to $410, resolved on Pyth prices) and for weekly closes. I could only see mirror sites, which showed prices from after the cutoff, so I have no usable pre-cutoff odds. [Predscope](https://predscope.com/event/googl-above-in-september-2026)
- I found no analyst consensus price target from before the cutoff.

## 6. Upcoming events before 2026-09-21
- Late August: Nvidia's Q2 earnings, a major read-through for AI spending (exact date not confirmed).
- Early September (about 08-31 to 09-04): ISM data and the August jobs report.
- Around 2026-09-08 to 09-10: Goldman Sachs Communacopia conference, where Alphabet will present (exact date not confirmed). [Alphabet IR](https://abc.xyz/investor/news/default.aspx)
- Any time: the ad tech remedies ruling. A breakup order would be a large downside risk, while behavioral-only remedies would likely be taken as a relief.
- Ongoing: the search antitrust appeal, plus EU Digital Markets Act and adtech actions.
- Around 2026-09-10 to 09-11: CPI and PPI releases (dates not confirmed).
- 2026-09-15 to 09-16: FOMC meeting, with the decision and projections on 09-16. One commentary source says the target range is 3.50-3.75% and that markets are weighing a hold against a hike. [Fed](https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/2026-september.htm), [ATFX](https://www.atfx.com/en-au/analysis/financial-events/september-fomc-meeting-2026-is-a-rate-hike-on-the-table)
- 2026-09-18: Monthly options expiration and quarterly index rebalancing, which can bring more volatility on the last trading day before resolution.
